items.title: Use Gemma 4 31B in IBM watsonx Orchestrate with Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: You can now use Gemma 4 31B in IBM watsonx Orchestrate, served through Amazon Bedrock. When you build AI agents for enterprise workflows, the model you choose shapes how your agents reason through multi-step tasks, call tools, and track long conversations. Gemma 4 31B is an open-weight model from Google DeepMind. It’s available in public preview […]
